nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_12
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Check how sharp the angle is between the two surface normals provided. Return true or false depending on whether or not the corner is within our limits.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_20
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment:
Chop off the decimal to prevent slight inaccuracies from causing wallruns to end (for example, flat walls would sometimes report 0.02 instead of 0 - which would cause a wall run to end incorrectly if the max corner angle was set to 0.\r
\r
This does mean there\'s about 1 more degree being allowed than desired (if max angle is 45, this would allow 45.9 to proceed), but I think it\'s the most elegant solution.

nodes.name: EdGraphNode_Comment_394
nodes.title: EdGraphNode_Comment
nodes.comment: Determines whether we\'re evaluating an inside or outside corner and returns the appropriate angle limit. We identify which way the wall is turning by getting the cross product of the two surface normals (negative z = turning left, positive z = turning right). Combining that with which side of the character the wall is on tells us if we\'re navigating an inside or outside corner.
